The '''mother''' of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who served as a part of the [[Squill Sifters/Legends|Squill Sifters]], a group of [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and [[Spy/Legends|spies]], during the [[Waymancy Storm]] of [[7811 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />
